item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.4

  • Marking a note complete now archives it — there is no separate "done" state, and the filters are simply All, Active and Archived
  • Delete notes straight from All Notes, with ten seconds to undo
  • The note preview sits at a normal height and shows when it was created and last updated along the bottom
  • Buttons respond across their whole surface, with hover and press feedback
